title: Tastes Like Data: Baked Goods Classifier
description: By Alyvia Vaughan and Katie Hannigan. A machine learning project analyzing 83,782 recipes from Food.com to classify baked goods using nutritional data. Features exploratory data analysis, statistical inference, and Random Forest modeling with 82.4% accuracy.

title: Prices Vary More By Store Than By Processing Level
description: An expository data visualization comparing food prices across NOVA processing levels at Walmart and Whole Foods. Used median and IQR to show that store choice impacts price far more than processing level.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization: Abortion-access burdens are geographically unequal
description: A data visualization website that explores abortion access across the United States through two contrasting narrative perspectives, allowing users to compare how the same data can support different arguments. It combines geographic mapping, policy context, and user-driven storytelling to highlight how visualization framing shapes public understanding of reproductive rights.

title: Bikewatching: Boston Bike Traffic Visualization
description: An interactive geospatial visualization of BlueBike station traffic in the Boston area using Mapbox and D3. Features bike lane overlays, traffic volume circles, time-of-day filtering, and color-coded flow direction.
